launch_single_job: launch a single SLURM training job for an EB-JEPA example with a given config file and overrides
launch_sweep: launch a parameter sweep across multiple jobs using submitit with optional wandb sweep integration
run_experiment: run an EB-JEPA experiment by dynamically importing the example module and passing a config
make_executor: create a submitit AutoExecutor with standard SLURM parameters including memory, CPUs, and GPU settings
create_wandb_sweep_config: create a wandb sweep configuration from a parameter grid with a specified metric and method
